name: How long does a full kitchen renovation usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen renovation usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen remodel typically takes between six and twelve weeks to complete, depending on the scope of structural changes and material lead times. The process begins with demolition and any custom framing alterations, followed by rough-in work for electrical outlets and plumbing lines. Next comes drywall installation, taping, and texturing, followed by cabinet setting, countertop fabrication, tile installation, and final painting. Unforeseen subfloor damage or delayed custom cabinet orders can extend the schedule. Working directly with our hands-on team helps minimize downtime, as we manage both the carpentry crew and specialized trade scheduling on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most full kitchen remodels take 6 to 12 weeks, depending on structural layout changes, trade rough-ins, and material lead times for cabinets and counters.
